messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're seeing p99 spikes on the hosted inference cluster after the 2026-03-15 runtime push (commit c4f9a2). p95 is up ~2x for short-chat workloads. Happening across eu-west and us-central. Suspect kernel selection/attention change (SDPA -> FlashAttention toggle).


dan: I see it too. Grafana trace: https://graf.redwood.internal/d/ABc123/kernel-latency?orgId=1 : three zones show increased tail. Error rates stable, just latency.


dryan: Repro steps I used (small seq len, high QPS):
```
# run locust-style tester
python perf_client.py --model gpt-small --seq 128 --qps 200 --duration 300 --api-key $TOKEN
```
Observed p99 jump from ~60ms -> ~320ms after warmup.

maria: @ryan thanks. I ran a curl check that toggles compile flags — when forcing SDPA it goes back down. Command I ran:
```
redwoodctl model config set --model gpt-small --kernel-prefer sdpa
redwoodctl reload-pool --pool hosted-eu-1
```
Result: p99 dropped to ~70ms within 20s.

ben: Noted. There's a recent change that flips kernel preference to FlashAttention for batched KV cache reuse (PR https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/1428). Maybe the heuristic misfires for short seqs. @maria can you capture a heap/profile? If FlashAttention has a fallback path, it may be thrashing.

maria: Uploaded flamegraph to the thread: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/flames/2769994321.svg — shows heavy memcpy in flash kernel path.

sre-bot: ALERT: latency.p99.hosted-eu-1 breached 250ms for 12m — incident created INC-2026-1172.

ryan: Quick mitigation: force kernel selection override for affected models to sdpa and roll the pool. I can deploy a runtime patch that short-circuits the heuristic while we investigate.

dan: Agreed. Also adding a perf regression test to CI that runs the perf_client script with seq=128 and asserts p99 < 120ms for gpt-small. We should gate kernel-selection changes behind that.

ben: FYI I reproduced locally by compiling with -O3 + vector intrinsics and saw the same regression. Compiling with safer flags (-O2, no fast-math) reduces tail. Possible codegen bug or memory alignment issue in new kernels.

maria: Action list:
- roll pool to sdpa override (in progress)
- open rollback PR for kernel selection heuristic (ben)
- add perf test to CI (dan)
- root cause: reproduce with tuned build matrix (ryan/ben)

ingest-bot: perf-test run queued: job/2769994321-perf-matrix. Expected runtime ~45m.

ryan: For reproduction/debug you can run the repro that toggles kernel at runtime to test paths quickly:
```
# toggle at runtime (unsafe, for debug only)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/runtime/v1/kernel-toggle \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","kernel":"flash","force":true}'
```
Then run perf_client; switch back with kernel=sdpa.

maria: Temporary fix rolled out: sdpa override applied to hosted-eu-1 and us-central pools. Latency p99 recovered to baseline. Leaving incident open for RCA and tests.

ben: I'll open PR for a telemetry flag to measure kernel fallback counts and memcpy stalls so we can detect similar regressions automatically.

dan: If anyone needs the exact commit id I rolled back to: runtime@b3a7d9 (pre-PR 1428). Will document in the incident.

maria: Thanks all. Let's sync tomorrow in eng-runtime async channel — please add findings to INC-2026-1172. :thumbsup:
